BROAD_SUPPORT.4_concentration: largest single-utterance share of sum_{d_u>0} d_u <= 0.5; D > 0 in >= 18 of 20 leave-one-dialogue-out panels; D restricted to non-termination-changed rows >= 5
BROAD_SUPPORT.5_retention: if B2 genuine-lexical POI corrections >= 3: fraction retained by B3 >= 0.8; else if B2 POI corrections >= 3: all-correction retention >= 0.8; else not assessable (passes, reported)
BROAD_SUPPORT.6_safety_vs_B2: MER(B3) <= MER(B2) + 0.002, PIER(B3) <= PIER(B2) + 0.01, new severe truncations and added caps (vs B0) of B3 <= those of B2
BROAD_SUPPORT.7_vs_AUTO: MER(B3) < MER(B1) and ZH-CER(B3) < ZH-CER(B1); PIER/EN-WER gap reported as the trade-off

decision_rule.INVALID: any integrity failure (regression oracle, B0/B1/B2 reuse identity, reset, non-LN change, missing rows, seal)
decision_rule.NOT_SUPPORTED: D <= 0, or genuine (else all-POI) correction retention < 0.5 when assessable, or MER(B3) > MER(B2) + 0.005
decision_rule.notation: N2 = new ZH corruptions of B2 vs B0; N3 = of B3 vs B0; D = N2 - N3; per-utterance d_u = newZH_B2(u) - newZH_B3(u)
